prompt: Style these districts by zone type
criteria: Must use categories shortcut: {"type": "top", "count": 10} (default when no count specified, not an explicit array)
Must include paint.color property (never omit it)
Color must be a categorical palette like '@catPalette4' (not an array, not SimplePalette HSL)
Must NOT include paint.size property (polygons don't have size)
Must use default opacity: 0.8 for polygons
